Artists on Main Street Program

North Dakota Main Street Initiative (MSI) is excited to announce the Artists on Main program will be expanded to five communities over 2022-2023. This accelerated program offers technical assistance and funding to develop and install art to one North Dakota MSI community. This unique opportunity consists of creative community development training, one-on-one technical assistance for artists and community leaders from placemaking experts, and financial support for up to five small projects that address local challenges affecting the vibrancy of their community.
